description:
JMAP-826m.8 propagated mail-server's canonical IdFate algorithm to metadata-server. Per the workspace AGENTS.md canonical-template propagation rule ("propagate the change to every sibling in the same pass, or file a follow-up sweep bead"), the 5 other extension-server siblings (jmap-chat-server, jmap-calendars-server, jmap-tasks-server, jmap-contacts-server, jmap-filenode-server, jmap-sharing-server) need an audit to confirm whether they share the same Vec::contains + retain dedup shape that metadata-server used to carry, and if so propagate IdFate to them too.

Scope:
- Read each sibling's MemoryBackend get_changes (and any per-extension override like metadata-server's get_metadata_changes).
- If the algorithm is the Vec::contains + retain shape (which puts created-then-destroyed-in-window in destroyed, the MAY variant), propagate IdFate there.
- If the algorithm already matches canonical IdFate, no change needed.
- If a sibling has a different non-canonical algorithm, file a separate decision bead.

For each sibling that needs propagation:
- Add IdFate enum (or share-import if/when the workspace consolidates the helper).
- Rewrite get_changes (and any override) to use HashMap<Id, IdFate>.
- Audit integration tests for create-then-destroy-in-window assertions; update to use sinceState past the seeds (sibling-test pattern from JMAP-826m.8's metadata-server fix).
- Run cargo fmt + clippy -p <crate> -- -D warnings + cargo test -p <crate> per sibling.

This is workspace-wide cookie-cutter cleanup, not a single-crate bug fix. File subtask beads per sibling if the audit finds work; otherwise close with a note documenting the per-sibling state.
title: Sibling audit: do chat/calendars/tasks/contacts/filenode/sharing-server MemoryBackends share metadata-server's pre-IdFate MAY-variant dedup divergence?
